title: Dorm Sweet Dorm
description: Deposit paid. You now own 50% of a mouldy room and 0% of a sleep schedule.

title: Till Debt Do Us Part
description: Uncle danced to the same song 7 times. The envelopes almost covered the bill. Almost.

title: Home Sweet Loan
description: You found the one. Three bedrooms, a garden, and a 30-year commitment. Now pick how you'd like to suffer:

options.name: Fixed Rate
options.description: Same instalment for years. Boring, predictable, and you sleep at night.

options.name: Variable Rate
options.description: Cheaper today, a mystery tomorrow. Your instalment now follows the central bank's mood swings.

options.name: Fixed for 5 Years
options.description: Stability now, a surprise later. Future-you will deal with it.

title: Surprise, It's a Baby!
description: A tiny human with a huge budget. Sleep is now a luxury product.

title: Promotion!
description: +30% salary. Your lifestyle immediately asks for +31%.

title: Midlife Crisis, Fully Financed
description: You turned 45. A red convertible seems like a good investment. Your wife disagrees.

options.name: Buy the Convertible
options.description: Wind in your (remaining) hair. Your savings are now shaped like a car.

options.name: Listen to Your Wife
options.description: You buy a bicycle instead. It's red, at least.

title: Buy High, Cry Low
description: The market just crashed. Your portfolio is down 30% and your banking app now opens with a trigger warning. What do you do?

options.name: Panic Sell
options.description: You lock in the loss. Stress gone, money gone.

options.name: Hold
options.description: Delete the app, touch grass, wait it out.

options.name: Buy the Dip
options.description: Everything is on sale. Very brave, or very early.

title: Empty Nest
description: The kid moved out with half your pots. Costs down! Calls for money: up.

title: The Final Stretch
description: Last raise before retirement. Maybe stop betting everything on stocks now?

title: Retirement!
description: Your pension letter arrives: 20% of your salary. Hope Past You saved something.
